description: This file defines the SchedulerDAO interface, which provides database access methods related to scheduling tasks within the OpenMRS platform. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting TaskDefinition objects, as well as fetching tasks by UUID or name.

classes.name: SchedulerDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for scheduler task management in OpenMRS.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new scheduler task in the database using the specified TaskDefinition.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its UUID.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks from the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the specified task object from the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by its internal ID from the database.

methods.name: getTaskByName
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its public name.
